title: Yoga Teacher Training
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 16S/24Q to fewer than 30S/45Q units

outcomes: Demonstrate comprehensive knowledge of yoga theory, anatomy, physiology, philosophy, and teaching methodology by integrating foundational concepts into both personal practice and instruction.
Design and lead safe, effective yoga classes that emphasize anatomical alignment, include appropriate modifications, and are adaptable to students of varying physical abilities and experience levels.
Analyze the historical and cultural roots of yoga, demonstrating an ethical and respectful approach to teaching that promotes cultural awareness and honors the tradition.
Apply personal practice experience to build teaching confidence and professionalism, preparing for employment in yoga instruction and related roles in the health, wellness, and fitness industries.
